'''0.21d''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that made the matchmaking process more strict and fixed some crashes.

==Changelog==
* Match making algorithm has been changed: works better, but players may wait longer
* Fixed crash after playing several matches in a row
* Fixed crash during visualization of player in squad with items with modifiers
